text: Added BaselineError plus buildEither/checkNuisanceEither/cleanNuisanceEither wrappers. NuisanceCheck.Error now returns BaselineError.NuisanceProblems with the NuisanceReport; missing nuisance input and invalid baseline inputs are structured errors. Legacy throwing APIs remain via unsafe wrappers. Verification: sbt -no-colors designJVM/test designJS/test passed, 127 tests on each platform.
